cronExpression.description: Null keeps the cron; non-null is re-parsed.

briefJson.description: Worker brief payload replacement; null keeps the stored value.

enabled.description: Null keeps the flag; false disables the dispatcher for this job.

description:
Scheduled job partial-update body
(`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/scheduled-jobs/{jobId}`).
Null fields leave the stored value untouched — the canonical PATCH
semantics. `cronExpression` is re-parsed on write; a malformed
value surfaces `400` with the `scheduler.invalid_cron`
code.
